edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient in the constructor.
Caller address is used in the ownership check path feeding excludeFromMaxTransaction.
Caller address flows into excludeFromFees through owner().
enableTrading writes lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp, making burn timing miner dependent.
_transfer compares block.timestamp + lpBurnFrequency against lastLpBurnTime to trigger LP burns.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens sets lastLpBurnTime = block.timestamp.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens enforces cooldown using block.timestamp arithmetic.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
tx.origin keys _holderLastTransferTimestamp, allowing relayed/wrapped calls to bypass per-address delay intent.
from parameter drives branch selection for buy/sell fee and limit logic.
to parameter drives branch selection and recipient checks.
amount parameter controls limit and fee arithmetic.
swapping flag gates reentrant swapBack and fee logic within transfers.
maxTransactionAmount constrains allowed transfer size.
maxWallet constrains recipient balance growth.
swapTokensAtAmount defines the swapBack trigger threshold.
Exemption mapping controls whether limit checks apply.
Fee exemption mapping controls takeFee and swapBack conditions.
AMM pair mapping determines buy/sell fee direction.
Per-origin last transfer block is checked and updated during transfers.
lpBurnEnabled gates the automatic LP burn branch.
sellTotalFees is used in fee multiplication and division for sell transfers.
buyTotalFees is used in fee multiplication and division for buy transfers.
_transfer invokes swapBack which performs external router calls and ETH transfers mid-transfer.
_transfer calls autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens which performs an external pair.sync().
swapBack performs state-changing external interaction reachable while _transfer is executing.
Low-level ETH send to devWallet inside swapBack executes before later balance-dependent transfers.
Low-level ETH send of full balance to marketingWallet ends swapBack with an external call.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert accrued tokens.
swapBack calls addLiquidity when liquidity tokens and ETH remain.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap external call.
addLiquidity invokes router addLiquidityETH external call.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() after burning.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() after burning.
Constructor initializes the AMM pair mapping through the helper.
Constructor calls excludeFromMaxTransaction for router, pair and exclusions.
Constructor calls excludeFromFees for owner, contract and dead address.
Constructor writes the created pair address into uniswapV2Pair.
Constructor writes the router address into uniswapV2Router.
enableTrading writes lastLpBurnTime from a timestamp value.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private setter.
pair parameter is written into the AMM pair mapping through the setter.
value parameter sets the boolean AMM pair flag.
updateBuyFees recomputes buyTotalFees from fee components.
updateSellFees recomputes sellTotalFees from fee components.
newMarketingWallet is written into the marketingWallet state variable.
newWallet is written into the devWallet state variable.
marketingWallet is the ETH recipient inside swapBack.
devWallet is the ETH recipient inside swapBack.
percentForLPBurn is multiplied against the LP balance to compute burn amount.
LP pair balance is multiplied and divided to derive amountToBurn.
LP pair balance is scaled by percent to derive the manual burn amount.
tokensForLiquidity participates in proportional ETH/token distribution math.
tokensForMarketing participates in proportional ETH distribution math.
tokensForDev participates in proportional ETH distribution math.
Computed fees are subtracted from the transfer amount.
amountToSwapForETH is passed to the router swap call.
liquidityTokens and ETH are supplied to addLiquidity.
ethForLiquidity is supplied as the ETH value for liquidity.
Marketing ETH share flows into the marketing wallet call.
Dev ETH share flows into the dev wallet call.
